scope: Owned combat implementation,18 initial targeted test files and8 additional approved historical fixture test files; source-only review. No browser, build, media or deployment certification.

semantics.holy: Damage bypasses both damage immunities; slowing/freezing respect Physical immunity; poison/burning/healing block respect Magical immunity. Explicit Golem petrification remains the only special status bypass.
semantics.dread: Positive actual HP damage attributed to the actual active owned defender triggers75% attack slowing for3 game seconds, at any range, including DOT, damage aura, secondary-chain and launched projectile damage. Blocks/mere proximity/phantom or consumed source do not trigger. Refreshes strongest amount without stacking; live control resistance applies; enemy death preserves the deadline; next wave clears it.
semantics.refraction: Three charges. Absolute elapsed+2 deadline begins only when final direct-hit charge is consumed. Live charges never reset periodically. An end-of-frame projectile cannot replenish shields within that same update.
semantics.recharge: 50% missing health every4 game seconds; actual block-expiry/pulse order retained.
semantics.blink: Six route tiles every5 game seconds, including split floating-point deadline and multiple deadlines per coarse update.
semantics.regeneration: 20% modified maximumHP/s; wave38 Blood-Leech40%. Actual maximumHP/healing block/cap verified.
semantics.console: dread.duration exposed; old dread.radius rejected. refraction.period is retained as a depletion-delay override; private run data never mutates frozen defaults.
